newsitem.title: UK: UK management buy-outs set to rise - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK management buy-outs set to rise - paper.

text.p: The number and value of management buy-outs in the UK is set to rise in the second half of the year according to figures from the Centre for Management Buy-Out Research, the Daily Telegraph said on Monday.
Buy-outs slowed during the second quarter as deals were delayed pending the outcome of the May 1 general election, the Telegraph said.
Delayed deals were now being completed, the paper said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
